name: Swap Rectangles
description: Swaps two rectangles of the frame, like FFmpeg's swaprect.

params.name: w
params.description: Rectangle width, fraction of the frame width (FFmpeg w, default w/2)

params.name: h
params.description: Rectangle height, fraction of the frame height (FFmpeg h, default h/2)

params.name: x1
params.description: First rectangle left edge, fraction of the frame width (FFmpeg x1)

params.name: y1
params.description: First rectangle top edge, fraction of the frame height (FFmpeg y1)

params.name: x2
params.description: Second rectangle left edge, fraction of the frame width (FFmpeg x2)

params.name: y2
params.description: Second rectangle top edge, fraction of the frame height (FFmpeg y2)
